newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Dollar climbs to record high vs Tunisian dinar.
newsitem.headline: Dollar climbs to record high vs Tunisian dinar.

text.p: The dollar climbed to its highest level against the Tunisian dinar since Tunisia's domestic forex market started in March 1994, dealers said.
By midday, the dollar was trading at 1.0565 dinars on the interbank market, against 1.0460 at Thursday's close.

"This is the dollar's highest level since the interbank forex market started. The (previous) record was on February 9, 1994 when (it) reached 1.0736 dinar. At the time, the rate was fixed by the Central Bank," Amen Bank dealing room chief Hatem Zaara said.
He said the rise reflected the dollar's surge on the internatinal market.
Despite the dollar's record level against the dinar, he noted the dollar's gains were tempered by high currency liquidity in Tunisia on Friday.
"There were important sellings of dollars today by two big non-banking operators," Zaara said.
